description: Find signatures that lead to more websites like the ones in a cluster: their common platform, theme, plugin, tracker, network or owner. Each result is a ready search - pass its query to the search tool in double quotes to find more such websites. Best on a cluster made by one search or of one network; a mixed cluster may give none. Sorted best first: in_cluster - how many of the websites looked at have the code, websites - rough count in the whole index (null when rarer than websites_max; the search gives the exact number), technology - its name when the code belongs to a technology we know. Spends nothing.

cluster.description: Cluster id, from list_clusters or create_cluster.
